question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring policy, fold this scenario into the broader origin-channel delivery policy, or keep WebChat isolated from external routes?
rationale: The change would intentionally duplicate Control UI output into external conversations selected from stored route state, so maintainer intent is needed for the product and security boundary.

options.title: Define explicit opt-in mirroring
options.body: Add a default-off session delivery policy with route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, failure, schema, docs, and live-channel proof requirements.

options.title: Fold into broader origin delivery
options.body: Use the broader origin/fallback delivery issue as the policy vehicle and keep this issue as its WebChat mirroring scenario until that design lands.

options.title: Reject mirroring
options.body: Keep WebChat isolated from external routes and document explicit message sends as the supported bridge.

recommendation.title: Define explicit opt-in mirroring
recommendation.body: Add a default-off session delivery policy with route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, failure, schema, docs, and live-channel proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and current blame owner for the relevant routing gates.
